articles.text: MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Nǐ zài xiě dōngxi, kuài qǐng zuòxia, bú yào kèqi.
AMERICAN TOURIST: You're writing, please sit down. Don't be polite.
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Wǒ lái bǎ zhèi jǐběn shū nákāi, nín zuòxia xiūxixiūxi.
YOUNG WOMAN: I'll move these books away and you can sit down and rest.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Zhèiběn Zhōngguó Gǔdàishǐ shi nǐde ma?
AMERICAN TOURIST: Is this History of Ancient China yours?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Shi wǒde. Zhèiběn shūli guānyú yíwèi Tángcháo huángdìde gùshi hé zhèige zhǎnlǎnhuìshang shuōde bú tài yíyàng, suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ ta xiěxialai dàihuiqu kànkan.

YOUNG WOMAN: Yes, it is. There are some differences between the version of a story about a Táng dynasty emperor in this book and the version given in the exhibit, so I'm writing it down to take home and read.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Nǐ shi Běifāng rén ma?
AMERICAN TOURIST: Are you from the north?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Wǒ lǎojiā zài Zhèjiāng, xiànzài zài Qīnghǎi gōngzuò, zhèicì shi lái Běijīng chūchāide.
YOUNG WOMAN: Originally I'm from Zhèjiāng, but now I work in Qīnghǎi. This time I'm in Běijīng on business.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Qīnghǎide xùmùyè hěn fādá ba?
AMERICAN TOURIST: Qīnghǎi's livestock farming is very developed, isn't it?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Xùmùyède qíngkuàng bú cuò, búguò méiyou Nèiměng, Xīnjiāng nàme hǎo.
YOUNG WOMAN: Livestock farming is doing well, but the situation isn't as good as in Inner Mongolia and Xīnjiāng.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Rénmínde shēnghuó shuǐpíng zěnmeyàng?
AMERICAN TOURIST: How is the people's standard of living?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Chīde chà yìdiǎnr, zhǔyào shi jiāotōng bù fāngbian, biéde shēnghuó fāngmiàn me, yě méiyou nèidì hǎo.
YOUNG WOMAN: The food is rather poor, but the main thing is that transportation is difficult. As for other aspects of life, well, they aren't as good as in the interior either.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Nǐ zài Qīnghǎi gōngzuò, zuò shénme ne?
AMERICAN TOURIST: What is your work in Qīnghǎi?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Dāngguo nóngmín, yě dāngguo Jiěfàngjūn, xiànzài zài yíge jiànzhù cáiliàochǎng dāng gōngren.
YOUNG WOMAN: I've been a peasant and I've been in the P.L.A. Now I'm a worker in a construction materials factory.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Ǹg, nǐ zuòguo bù shǎode shìqing.
AMERICAN TOURIST: Mm, you've done a lot of things.
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Xiànzài bù shǎo niánqīng rén dōu shi zhèiyangrde. Kěshi wǒ zuì yǒu xīngqùde hái shi lìshǐ.
YOUNG WOMAN: These days a lot of young people are like that. But I'm still most interested in history.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Nǐ yào shàng dàxué niàn lìshǐ ma?
AMERICAN TOURIST: Do you want to go to college to study history?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Yào. Duì le, nín kàn Zhōngwén bào ma?
YOUNG WOMAN: Yes, I do. Oh, do you read the Chinese newspapers?
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Kàn.
AMERICAN TOURIST: Yes.
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Zhèi liǎngtiānde Rénmín Rìbào nín kànguo ma?
YOUNG WOMAN: Have you been reading the People's Daily the last couple of days?
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Kànguo le. Bàoshang shuō hěn duō dàxué yào bàn hánshòubān le.
AMERICAN TOURIST: Yes. It said in the paper that a lot of colleges are going to start correspondence courses.
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Duì le, suǒyǐ wǒ zài zhèr zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
YOUNG WOMAN: Right, so I'm preparing to take the exams here.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Zhèizhǒng dàxué zěnme niàn ne?
AMERICAN TOURIST: How do you go about attending these colleges?

NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Kǎoshangle yǐhòu, xuéxiào jiù gěi wǒmen shū hé xuéxí cáiliào, wǒmen zìjǐ zìxué, ànshí bǎ zuòyè hé kǎoshì jiāo gěi xuéxiào. Gōngchǎng fàng jiàde shíhou wǒ kěyi huí lǎojiā qu kàn fùmǔ, hái kěyi qù dàxué xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjiào.

YOUNG WOMAN: After we pass the exam, the school sends us the books and other study materials, and we study on our own, turning in our homework and tests when required. When I have vacation from the factory, I can go back to my hometown to visit my parents, and I can also go to the college to ask for help from the teachers.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Nà bú cuò ma, zhèiyang niàn shū yě kěyi yǒu dàxué bìyède shuǐpíng ma?
AMERICAN TOURIST: That's pretty good. By going to school like that can you reach the level of a college graduate?
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Kěyi. Zhōngguó gǔdàishǐ shi hěn yǒu yìside, wǒ yídìng yào hǎohāor niàn.
YOUNG WOMAN: Yes, you can. Ancient Chinese history is very interesting. I'm determined to study hard.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Hǎo, zhù nǐ chénggōng!
AMERICAN TOURIST: Good, I wish you success!
NIÁNQĪNG FÙNǙ: Xièxie ni!
YOUNG WOMAN: Thank you!
